mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR , t1.JM_CD , t1.JM_NM , t1.JASAN_GB , t1.BALH_NATION , t1.CURRENCY , t1.AEKM , TO_CHAR(t1.SANGJ_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sangj_ymd , t1.SANGJ_JUSU , t1.BLBG_TCKR , t1.BLBG_TCKR_TEXT , t1.ISIN_CD , t1.SIGA_AGENT , t1.JASAN_ATTR , t1.SJ_GB , t1.SEDOL , t1.FEN0055 , t1.BALH_NM , t1.JASAN , t1.GBX , t1.STOCK_GB , t1.SRS_CD , 1 AS p_visible FROM SYM0YA t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.JASAN_GB = '1' ORDER BY t1.BALH_NATION ASC , t1.JM_CD ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYM0YA ( CORP_GR, JM_CD, JM_NM, JASAN_GB, JS_JONGRYU, BALH_NATION, CURRENCY, AEKM, SANGJ_YMD, SANGJ_JUSU, BLBG_TCKR, BLBG_TCKR_TEXT, ISIN_CD, SIGA_AGENT, JASAN_ATTR, SJ_GB, SEDOL, FEN0055, BALH_NM, JASAN, GBX, STOCK_GB, SRS_CD ) VALUES ( #{corpGr}, #{jmCd}, #{jmNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{jasanGb, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '1'), COALESCE(#{jsJongryu, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '1'), #{balhNation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{currency, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{aekm, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, CASE WHEN #{sangjYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(#{sangjYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) != '' THEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{sangjYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '[^0-9]', ''), 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE NULL END, #{sangjJusu, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{blbgTckr, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{blbgTckrText, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isinCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sigaAgent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{jasanAttr, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sjGb, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sedol, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fen0055, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{balhNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{jasan, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{gbx, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), #{stockGb, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{srsCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
